## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
Verses and themes from the text are quoted or discussed across later canonical and paracanonical literature, including the *Mahāniddesa* (Mnd 16 *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa*), the *Kathāvatthu* (Kv 3.9), and several dilemmas in the *Milindapañha* (Mil 7.2.1, 7.5.7, 7.6.10) [SuttaCentral].
The verses of the *Sāriputtattheragāthā* share extensive parallels and text-reuse alignments across Pali, Sanskrit, Gāndhārī, Tibetan, and Chinese Buddhist corpora [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Curated passage-level parallels identified by SuttaCentral link verses of the text to other Pali discourses, such as AN 10.12 (*Pañcaṅgasutta*), SN 9.14 (*Gandhatthenasutta*), SN 11.15 (*Rāmaṇeyyakasutta*), Ud 3.4 (*Sāriputta Sutta*), and Ja 392 (*Siṅghapupphajātaka*), as well as verses in other poems of the collection, notably Thag 1.74 and Thag 14.1 (*Khadiravaniyarevatattheragāthā*) [SuttaCentral]. Many stanzas correspond to verses in the *Dhammapada* (Dhp 76, 77, 98, 99, 315) and their counterparts across parallel Dharmapada and Udānavarga recensions, including the Gāndhārī Dharmapada, the Patna Dharmapada, the Sanskrit *Udānavarga*, Tibetan versions, and early Chinese verse anthologies (T 210, T 212, T 213) [SuttaCentral].
DharmaNexus corroborates these relationships, detecting strong text-reuse matches with the Patna Dharmapada, alongside alignments with Chinese Āgama literature (the *Madhyama Āgama*, T 26) and Tibetan works such as the *Saddharmānusmṛtyupasthāna* [DharmaNexus]. Within Pali literature, DharmaNexus registers substantial text reuse with Thag 14.1, the *Dhammapada*, the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 6.14), and the *Lābhasakkāra Saṁyutta* (SN 17.10), as well as dense citation throughout the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Dhammapada-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Saddanītippakaraṇaṃ* [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
